en.headline: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay this weekend with…
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival runs 14-15 November at Victoria Park, featuring illuminated night and grand finale parades with giant puppets.
body: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay on 14 and 15 November for its largest edition to date, organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation.

The free event at Victoria Park Central Lawn runs from 10am to 5pm both days and includes 17 interactive arts booths, live storytelling in English and Cantonese, African drumming workshops, more than 60 stage performances and an exhibition of over 900 student artworks.

On Saturday 14 November the illuminated Night Parade starts at 8.30pm from Lee Garden One and travels through the Lee Gardens area, featuring five giant illuminated puppets and 18 sparkling costumes. On Sunday 15 November the Grand Finale Parade begins at 2.30pm in Victoria Park, with ten four-metre-tall fairy-tale puppets leading around 500 young performers along Great George Street.

Organisers said the programme celebrates classic fairy tales and the values of courage, integrity and wisdom, with roaming giant puppets appearing for photographs throughout the weekend. Full details are available on the official event website.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華本周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話主題巨型木偶巡遊免費開放
zh.dek: 活動於11月14至15日在維多利亞公園舉行，夜光巡遊及壓軸巡遊將有巨型木偶帶領青年表演者遊行。
body: 渣打藝趣嘉年華於11月14及15日重臨銅鑼灣，由香港青年藝術協會主辦，是歷來規模最大的一屆。
免費活動在維多利亞公園中央草坪舉行，每日上午10時至下午5時開放，設有17個互動藝術攤位、英粵語現場說故事、非洲鼓工作坊、逾60場舞台表演及超過900件學生作品展覽。
周六晚上8時30分夜光巡遊由利園一期正門出發，途經利園區，有五座發光巨型木偶及18套華麗服裝；周日下午2時30分壓軸巡遊由維園出發，十座高達4米的童話巨型木偶帶領約500名青年表演者沿記利佐治街遊行。
主辦單位表示，今屆以經典童話為主題，強調勇氣、正直與智慧，巨型木偶會在周末期間驚喜現身供市民合照。詳情可參閱官方網站。
